{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "vicjuma",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked about the risks motivating the wipe and suggested implementing a destructor at the CSHA512 class level"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4298093510",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "what risks or motivation exist for cleansing the digest here",
      "quote": "Any motivation to this other than: ... are there any risks posed here?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "fametrano explained that key and IV material from the passphrase remain on the stack until overwritten, posing risk in crash dumps or memory bugs",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4298854739"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4298854739",
      "status_by_quote": "The risk is small: after the function returns, the key and IV derived from the passphrase stay on the stack until overwritten, where a crash dump or another memory bug could expose them."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4298093510",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "create a destructor at the CSHA512 class level rather than wiping individual finalized digests",
      "quote": "creating a destructor at the class level should be the way to go, imo; otherwise, we will be going into a cleaning spree for every finalized digest",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fametrano updated the PR to cleanse state and buffer in CSHA512's destructor and removed the wipe in crypter.cpp",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4298854739"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4298854739",
      "status_by_quote": "Agreed, done: CSHA512 now cleanses its state and buffer in its destructor, as ChaCha20 does, and the line in crypter.cpp is gone."
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "vicjuma questioned the motivation for wiping at the call site and suggested a class-level destructor instead; fametrano adopted the suggestion and pushed the update.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "review of the updated class-level destructor implementation from vicjuma or other reviewers",
      "id": "rc:4298854739"
    }
  ]
}
